name: Controller
description: The natural or legal person that, alone or jointly with others, determines the purpose and means of processing personal data (§ 59.1-575).
threshold: At least 100,000 consumers, or at least 25,000 consumers and over 50 percent of gross revenue from the sale of personal data (§ 59.1-576(A))

name: Processor
description: A natural or legal entity that processes personal data on behalf of a controller (§ 59.1-575).
threshold: Determined by contract with a controller pursuant to § 59.1-579(B)

name: Consumer
description: A natural person who is a resident of the Commonwealth acting only in an individual or household context; does not include a natural person acting in a commercial or employment context (§ 59.1-575).
threshold: Virginia resident acting in an individual or household context

name: Child
description: Any natural person younger than 13 years of age (§ 59.1-575).

name: Minor
description: For purposes of § 59.1-577.1, any natural person younger than 16 years of age.

name: Parent
description: A parent or legal guardian of a child or minor (§ 59.1-575). A known child's parent or legal guardian may invoke consumer rights on behalf of the child (§ 59.1-577(A)).

name: Third Party
description: A natural or legal person, public authority, agency, or body other than the consumer, controller, processor, or an affiliate of the processor or the controller (§ 59.1-575).

name: Affiliate
description: A legal entity that controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with another legal entity or shares common branding with another legal entity (§ 59.1-575).
threshold: More than 50 percent ownership or voting power, control over a majority of directors, or controlling influence over management

name: User
description: A person not acting as an agent of a controller or processor (§ 59.1-575).
threshold: Not an agent of a controller or processor

name: Virginia Attorney General
description: The Attorney General shall have exclusive authority to enforce the provisions of this chapter (§ 59.1-584(A)) and is empowered to issue civil investigative demands (§ 59.1-583).
